description: This Java source file defines a helper class for integration testing within the Apache Fineract project. It provides methods to create and retrieve data related to cashiers and tellers, specifically for testing transactions and summaries in the organization.teller context. It includes utility methods for generating JSON payloads and performing HTTP POST requests, as well as methods to retrieve transaction data via API calls.

classes.name: CashierTransactionsHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing cashier-related transactions and data retrieval in integration tests, including creating tellers and cashiers, and fetching transaction summaries.

methods.name: getTellersTellerIdCashiersCashiersIdTransactionsResponse
methods.description: Retrieves transaction data for a specific cashier under a teller, with pagination and sorting options.

methods.name: getTellersTellerIdCashiersCashiersIdSummaryAndTransactionsResponse
methods.description: Retrieves transaction summaries and data for a specific cashier under a teller.

methods.name: createTeller
methods.description: Creates a new teller via a POST request, returning its resource ID.

methods.name: createTellerWithJson
methods.description: Creates a teller using a provided JSON payload, returns response as a map.

methods.name: createTellerAsJSON
methods.description: Generates a JSON string representing a new teller with predefined properties.

methods.name: getMapWithStartDate
methods.description: Returns a map with date-related fields for starting date configuration.

methods.name: createCashier
methods.description: Creates a new cashier via a POST request, returning its resource ID.

methods.name: createCashierWithJson
methods.description: Creates a cashier using a provided JSON payload, returns response as a map.

methods.name: createCashierAsJSON
methods.description: Generates a JSON string for creating a cashier with specific fields.

methods.name: getMapWithDates
methods.description: Returns a map with date range and full-day flag for cashier creation.
